answer: Delayed Beacon Admission.** Each round, a public verifiable random function (VRF) emits a seed only after agents commit a blinded registration token, so attackers can't precompute which identities land in the scarce admission island of each epoch. Enrollment slots are assigned by ranking committed tokens against the late seed, and a per-identity atlas of prior admissions flags repeats. The seed is drawn atop a ridge of independent beacons, so grinding one source gains nothing.
